agent_compatibility.evidence: Measured 2026-07-26 on Claude Code 2.1.220 with CommandMate 0.15.0. An installed skill was discovered from .claude/skills and matched in the slash palette; the installer writes .agents/skills and .claude/skills byte-identically.

Measured 2026-07-26 on Codex CLI 0.145.0. It reads SKILL.md from .agents/skills (model self-report of the absolute path, not a mechanical trace). This version does not expose skills as slash commands; invoke by name or run the scripts.
Not measured for this version. Readable as a procedure; discovery unverified.

Measured 2026-08-25 on opencode 1.18.22 (CommandMate#2037) and re-checked 2026-09-04 on 1.18.27: GET /skill lists SKILL.md from .agents/skills and .claude/skills; submitting /<name> loads the skill. Scanned at boot, restart after install. Not in opencode's own slash palette.

Measured 2026-09-04 on Command Code 1.47.0 (CommandMate#2322): discovered from .agents/skills (cmd skills list, /skills picker); /<name> emits skill_loaded and runs. .claude/skills is not read; the installer's .agents/skills copy suffices. No restart needed.

Measured 2026-09-29 on opencode2 2.0.18 (CommandMate#2975): GET /api/skill lists SKILL.md from .agents/skills and .claude/skills; /<name> makes the model call the skill tool. No restart needed. Not in v2's / palette (@ and /skills only). This package was NOT separately measured.
